roles/dataproc.editor.title: Dataproc Editor
roles/dataproc.editor.desc: Provides the permissions necessary for viewing the resources required to manage Managed Service for Apache Spark, including machine types, networks, projects, and zones.

roles/dataproc.hubAgent.title: Dataproc Hub Agent
roles/dataproc.hubAgent.desc: Allows management of Dataproc resources. Intended for service accounts running Dataproc Hub instances.

roles/dataproc.serverlessEditor.title: Dataproc Serverless Editor
roles/dataproc.serverlessEditor.desc: Permissions needed to run serverless sessions and batches as a user

roles/dataproc.serverlessNode.title: Dataproc Serverless Node.
roles/dataproc.serverlessNode.desc: Node access to Dataproc Serverless sessions and batches. Intended for service accounts.

roles/dataproc.serverlessViewer.title: Dataproc Serverless Viewer
roles/dataproc.serverlessViewer.desc: Permissions needed to view serverless sessions and batches

roles/dataproc.serviceAgent.title: Dataproc Service Agent
roles/dataproc.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Dataproc Service Account access to service accounts, compute resources, storage resources, and kubernetes resources. Includes access to service accounts.

roles/dataproc.viewer.title: Dataproc Viewer
roles/dataproc.viewer.desc: Provides read-only access to Managed Service for Apache Spark resources.

roles/dataproc.worker.title: Dataproc Worker
roles/dataproc.worker.desc: Provides worker access to Managed Service for Apache Spark resources. Intended for service accounts.
